name: University of Bolton

facts.text: The University of Bolton was known by that name until 2024, when it became the University of Greater Manchester.
The University of Greater Manchester's address is Deane Road, Bolton, BL3 5AB (tel +44 (0)1204 900 600).
The university's preferred teaching approach is the 'Greater Manchester Way', which uses a block-teaching model on many (not all) courses.

sources.notes: Reached via 301 redirect from knowledge.bolton.ac.uk. Describes the UKVI credibility interview: conducted by 'a UKVI member of staff', 'usually last 30 minutes', in English. Invitation triggers: 'if more information is needed for your application if there are documents or information that needs clarifying, if you are processing to another course or postgraduate study, or if there are discrepancies with your visa or immigration history.' 'If you do not attend your credibility interview then your visa may be refused'. No mention of a university-run pre-CAS interview, CAS Shield or Enroly.

sources.title: University of Bolton: live CAS Shield tenant (bolton.cas-shield.com)
sources.notes: Probed 8 September 2026: the subdomain answers HTTP 200 with the Enroly CAS Shield sign-in page (random subdomains answer nothing), so the university runs its CAS process through Enroly. CAS Shield interviews follow the themes in Brunel's published policy; whether this university switches the interview on for every Nepali applicant is not stated here.
